patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Example Overlay Addon
patches.description:
Example-only Hill Climb Racing (com.fingersoft.hillclimb) addon for UniPatches Universal Overlay.
        Adds six mock-only preview modules: Add Coins, Add Gems, Add Paints, Vehicle Selection, Stage Selection, and Garage Selection.

        Options are disabled by default.
        
        Settings and previews are session-only and never change game state or bytecode.
